MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
